stem:
The diagram shows a $3$ by $1$ by $1$ solid of unit cubes on an isometric grid. Sameer wants to read its length, depth, and height from the grid.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Count $3$ units along length, $1$ along depth, and $1$ along height using the three isometric grid directions.
Count only on a square grid; the three isometric directions are not needed.
The three isometric grid directions are produced by the $3$ by $1$ by $1$ solid.
Add $3+1+1$ on one axis to get the solid's size.

tikz: \begin{tikzpicture}[line join=round,scale=0.9]\coordinate (O) at (0,0);\coordinate (A) at (3.0,0);\coordinate (B) at (2.4,0.42);\coordinate (Ot) at (0,1.05);\coordinate (At) at (3.0,1.05);\coordinate (Bt) at (2.4,1.47);\coordinate (Ct) at (-0.6,1.47);\coordinate (C) at (-0.6,0.42);\draw[gray!50,line width=0.3pt] (-1.0,-0.25)--(3.6,-0.25);\draw[gray!50,line width=0.3pt] (-1.3,0.17)--(3.3,0.17);\draw[gray!50,line width=0.3pt] (-1.6,0.59)--(3.0,0.59);\draw[gray!50,line width=0.3pt] (0,-0.35)--(0,1.9);\draw[gray!50,line width=0.3pt] (1.0,-0.35)--(1.0,1.9);\draw[gray!50,line width=0.3pt] (2.0,-0.35)--(2.0,1.9);\draw[gray!50,line width=0.3pt] (3.0,-0.35)--(3.0,1.9);\draw[thick,fill=gray!10] (O)--(A)--(At)--(Ot)--cycle;\draw[thick,fill=gray!22] (A)--(B)--(Bt)--(At)--cycle;\draw[thick,fill=gray!34] (Ot)--(At)--(Bt)--(Ct)--cycle;\draw[thick] (1.0,0)--(1.0,1.05);\draw[thick] (2.0,0)--(2.0,1.05);\end{tikzpicture}

teacher.key_rationale: On an isometric grid, length, depth, and height align with the three grid directions; count 3, 1, and 1 along those axes. Dropping the isometric directions, reversing solid and grid, or adding the three measures on one axis all miss the hinge.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote the square-grid kite into a 3×1×1 rectangular solid on an isometric-style grid.
